inputs.checklistItemText: Adjacent driveways within 300 feet not shown on plans (DRV-04)
inputs.question: Are adjacent driveways on neighboring properties within 300 feet shown on this sheet? Look for driveways on adjacent properties along the street frontages. When identifying adjacent driveways, look for two wide, flat-bottomed U-shapes or J-shapes side by side with a gap between them.
inputs.regionHint: along Collier Street and Kinney Avenue frontages, on adjacent properties

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/feature-identification question ('Are adjacent driveways shown on this sheet?'), which is a sheet-discovery and feature-presence check. Although the checklist requirement involves a 300-foot distance threshold, the agent is not asking for a measurement between driveways; it is asking whether adjacent driveways appear on the sheet at all as a prerequisite step.
